colors.doc:
Supporting text one step below the primary label: subtitles, helper text, and secondary values that still have to read easily.
Not a caption tier — the caption tokens are smaller and quieter, and swapping one for the other changes the hierarchy rather than the weight.
colors.name: labelSecondary
labelDisabled
colors.note: The one label that is allowed to fail contrast — nothing is read from it.

colors.doc: Label over an accent fill, in both appearances.
colors.name: labelOnAccent
colors.note: Fixed on purpose: the fill it sits on does not invert.

colors.name: surfacePrimary
colors.note: The page. Warm off-white rather than pure white.

colors.name: fillGrid
colors.note: Black and white rather than the ink and paper tokens: a grid line reads as a tint of the surface under it, whatever that surface is.

colors.name: interactiveDisabledLabel
colors.note: 0.3 × 255 is 76.5 — the one alpha in this palette that lands exactly between two bytes, and the byte the Kotlin table carries is 0x4D.

colors.doc: Accent — indicators and active hairlines. Never a fill.
colors.name: accent

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif

fonts.doc: The largest title on a screen: top-level navigation titles, onboarding and hero surfaces.
fonts.name: largeTitle
fonts.note: Large `opsz` and high `SOFT` — the display cut, not the body cut scaled up.

fonts.doc: Default body text — paragraphs, list rows, descriptions.
fonts.group: Body — the serif face at reading sizes
fonts.name: bodyRegular
fonts.note: `opsz` tracks the point size here rather than the display sizes above.

fonts.group: Body — the serif face at reading sizes
fonts.name: bodyEmphasized

fonts.doc: Inline title for collapsed navigation bars, key values, and card titles. A UI title, not a content heading.
fonts.name: headline

fonts.doc: Metadata, timestamps, and quiet supporting information.
fonts.name: footnoteRegular
fonts.note: Every mono label carries 0.08 em of tracking; the face is set in ALLCAPS at these sizes and reads tight without it.

fonts.name: footnoteMedium
fonts.note: The same 13/17 metrics as `footnoteRegular` — medium is a weight step, not a size step, so a regular-to-medium swap must not resize the text.

gradients.doc: The one gradient the design system keeps.
gradients.name: surfaceWash
gradients.note: Both stops are the raised surface at different alphas, so the wash reads as a fade rather than as a second colour.

gradients.doc: The wash behind a hero header.
gradients.name: surfaceHero
gradients.note: The two-appearance form: each appearance runs down its own surface ramp, so the wash inverts with the page instead of staying a light wash on a dark ground.
